question_text: Complete the following text with right forms of the verbs given in the box. 0.5  10 =
stimulus: base praise understand depend judge have pass discover see read The greatness of a book (a) ⎯⎯ mainly on the acceptability among the readers. If we read a book only once, we (b) ⎯⎯ many things in it. But (c) ⎯⎯ on one reading, we (d) ⎯⎯ the standard of a book. When a book (e) ⎯⎯ highly, we (f) ⎯⎯ no doubt about the standard of a book. Only through the first reading we may (g) ⎯⎯ a book but if it is (h) ⎯⎯ more than once we (i) ⎯⎯ why it was read and praised, so, the great books are those that have (j) ⎯⎯ the test of time.
guide_solution: Right form of verbs (a) depends (b) may see (c) basing (d) cannot judge (e) is praised (f) have (g) not understand (h) read (i) can discover (j) passed
